hotel_name: Saltstayz Premier - Galleria Market Road & Sector 27

positive_snippets:
I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The staff was very polite and helpful.
I would especially like to appreciate Varsha at reception for her excellent communication skills and warm hospitality. She was very professional, friendly, and made the check-in process smooth and pleasant. Thank you for the great service!

😊💙 Warm smiles, wonderful hospitality, and an unforgettable experience at Salt Stage, Gurgaon!

I had such an incredible experience at Salt Stage, Gurgaon. From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with genuine smiles, and the team looked after us exceptionally well throughout our stay.

A special thanks to Alok Sir and Varsha — they truly went out of their way to ensure everything was perfect. Their care, attention, and hospitality made us feel completely at home.

The service was top-notch, and the food was absolutely amazing — every dish was delicious and beautifully served. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and excellent service.

We were a large group of around 45 people, staying at the hotel for a big party event, and everything was managed seamlessly. From coordination to comfort, it was all very well looked after.

The beautiful ambience and the lovely view added so much charm to the experience and made our stay even more special.

Highly recommended for group stays, celebrations, and events. I will surely be coming back!

I had a pleasant stay at the hotel. The rooms were clean and well-maintained, staff were courteous and responsive, and the check-in/check-out process was smooth. Overall, a comfortable and hassle-free experience. I would recommend this hotel to others.
